author: GretchenMarina
text: A collaboration with 58 co-authors representing 28 institutions, the report itself has been an exercise in trust and cooperation and I am honored and humbled to be a part of it, and to support ongoing work in this area.

author: GretchenMarina
text: Developers can use these tools to provide evidence that AI systems are safe, secure, fair, or privacy-preserving. Users, policymakers, and civil society can use these tools to evaluate AI development processes.

author: GretchenMarina
text: This report describes 10 institutional, software, and hardware mechanisms that can help us begin to do so.

author: GretchenMarina
text: While a growing number of organizations have adopted ethics principles to guide their AI development process, we need to move beyond principles if we wish to enable those outside of an organization to verify whether AI systems were actually built according to stated principles.
